description: Semantic retrieval cases for hermes-retrieval-hybrid.js. These queries use natural language that requires conceptual understanding, not just keyword matching. Cases are tagged with requiredBackends to indicate which backend(s) must succeed. CI-safe: keyword-only cases degrade gracefully when grepai is unavailable.

modes.keyword: hermes-retrieval-hybrid.js --query Q --skip-embedding (pure BM25 + query rewriting + metadata scoring)

cases.description: Conceptual: 'double posting' → tools/social-publish-gate.js. Keyword-only misses; hybrid ranks #1 via embedding.
Conceptual: 'discovers computers on local network' → gatewayDiscovery.ts. Keyword-only misses; hybrid finds it via embedding (rank varies with index freshness, so k=15).
cases.query: mobile app discovers computers on local network

cases.description: Regression guard: 'agent coordination rules' → docs/agents/coordination.md. Both backends should find this.
cases.query: where are agent coordination rules documented

cases.description: Conceptual: 'singleton resource leasing chrome' → tools/resource-lease.js. Keyword finds it; hybrid should not regress it beyond top-20. Note: file not yet in grepai index (isolated clone behind), so hybrid preserves keyword ranking at a larger k.
cases.query: singleton resource leasing for shared chrome

cases.description: Conceptual: 'USB watchdog kill switch' → tools/hermes-hardware-leash.js. Both should find via path tokens.
cases.query: hardware leash USB watchdog kill switch reverse tether

cases.description: Same as social-publish-gate but using --mode rrf instead of weighted blend.
